description: A German SME developing AI-based predictive maintenance software for manufacturing lines. We use machine learning on sensor and vibration data to forecast equipment failures and reduce unplanned downtime.
A Danish green-energy startup building offshore wind turbine optimisation and smart-grid integration software to increase renewable energy efficiency and grid stability.
A French health-data startup applying NLP and federated learning to clinical records to support earlier diagnosis while preserving patient privacy across hospitals.
A Spanish agri-tech SME building precision-farming tools that combine drone imagery and machine learning to optimise irrigation, detect crop disease, and cut fertiliser use.
A Dutch logistics SME developing AI route-optimisation and warehouse automation software to reduce delivery emissions and improve supply-chain resilience.
An Italian cybersecurity SME building anomaly-detection and threat-intelligence tooling for industrial IoT devices and critical infrastructure networks.
An Irish fintech startup using machine learning for real-time fraud detection and anti-money-laundering compliance for payment providers.
A Luxembourg space-tech SME turning satellite earth-observation data into analytics for environmental monitoring, methane-leak detection, and land-use change.
A Swedish circular-economy SME building robotic sorting and AI material-recognition systems to increase recycling rates for plastics and electronic waste.
A Portuguese e-mobility startup developing smart EV-charging management and battery-health analytics to balance charging load on local grids.
